## Oil Shark (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
N Huge magical beast (aquatic, extraplanar, fire)  
**Init** +6; **Senses** Blindsense 30 ft., keen scent 180 ft.; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 10, flat-footed 19 (+2 Dex, +9 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 130 (10d10+30)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +9, **Will** +6  
**DR** 5/ -; **Immune** fire  
**Weakness** vulnerability to cold  


**Offense**


**Speed** Swim 60 ft.  
**Melee** bite +15 (2d6+9)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 23, **Dex** 15, **Con** 17, **Int** 1, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 2  
**Base Atk** +10 **CMB** +18; **CMD** 31  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Escape Artist +13 (+21 vs. grapple), Perception +8, Swim +20; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Escape Artist to escape a grapple  


**Special Abilities**


**Keen Scent (Ex)** An oil shark can notice creatures by scent in a 180-foot radius and detect blood in oil or water at ranges of up to one mile.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** Sea of Fire (Plane of Fire and Plane of Molten Skies)  
**Organization** solitary, school (2-5), or pack (6-11)  
**Treasure** none
